hero.title: A Hideaway in the Clouds
hero.subtitle: Luxury bungalows, mountain tents, family retreats, and unforgettable outdoor experiences in the heart of Qrayat, Akkar.

about.title: Inspired by the Mountain
about.text: Mont-Ranta offers a peaceful escape into nature where families, couples, and groups can reconnect away from city life. Nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of Qrayat, our eco-tourism retreat blends luxury with the raw beauty of Akkar.

accommodations.title: Our Accommodations
accommodations.subtitle: Find your perfect retreat. From cozy tents to luxury bungalows, we have something for every type of nature lover.
accommodations.bungalowDesc: Experience ultimate comfort with our luxury bungalows featuring a private deck and stunning valley views.

packages.title: Curated Experiences
packages.subtitle: Whether you're looking for romance, family fun, or a bonfire firewood gathering, our packages are designed for unforgettable moments.

footer.desc: Experience the peace of nature in our luxury bungalows and mountain tents in the heart of Qrayat, Akkar.

basicTent.name: Basic Tent
basicTent.description: A cozy, minimalist tent perfect for adventurers who want to sleep under the stars. Includes essential bedding and shared facilities.

domeTent.name: Special Tent
domeTent.description: Experience glamping at its finest in our spacious special tents. Features comfortable beds, panoramic windows, and private seating area.

stoneHouse.name: Stone House
stoneHouse.description: Our premium traditional stone house offering luxury and heritage. Complete with a private terrace, en-suite bathroom, and breathtaking valley views.

marriage.name: Marriage Retreat
marriage.description: A romantic getaway designed for newlyweds or anniversaries. Includes private dining, special room decor, and a guided sunset hike.

family.name: Family Adventure
family.description: Reconnect with your loved ones. Features a large accommodation setup, kid-friendly activities, and an exclusive BBQ night.

friends.name: Friends Camping (Small Tents)
friends.description: Gather your friends for a classic camping experience in a cluster of small tents around a shared bonfire pit.
